name: Tardo Lobisomem
body:
Tardo Lobisomem
CR 4

XP 1,200
NE Small fey (shapechanger)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10; Aura frightful presence (10 ft., DC 16, 1d6 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 19, flat-footed 13 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 39 (6d6+18)
Fort +4, Ref +10, Will +6
DR 5/cold iron; SR 15

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dagger +9 (1d4+1/19-20) or dagger +7 (1d4+1/19-20) and claw +7 (1d4)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 9th, concentration +12)

1/day—nightmare (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 20, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 13, Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 17
Feats Dodge, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +12, Climb +10, Disguise +9, Escape Artist +14, Intimidate +12, Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +10, Sense Motive +7, Stealth +18
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ change shape (any Small animal or humanoid, or a dire wolf, alter self or beast shape II), frightful nightmares

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Frightful Nightmares (Su)

A creature that fails its saving throw against a lobisomem’s frightful presence is affected as nightmare (DC 16) the next time it falls asleep. If its shaken condition is ended with remove fear or a similar magical effect, the nightmare does not occur. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, or gang (one lobisomem plus 2-7 tardos)
Treasure standard (masterwork dagger and other treasure)

Lobisomems are masters among their tardo kind, cruel and savage creatures with greater malice than their lesser kin and able to bend them to their will. They relish cruelty and the terror they inspire and some say the nightmares they create are contagious, afflicting all they meet.
